🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector breadth is positive but leadership is narrow (Top 5 = ABBV, MRK, JNJ, DHR, TMO all ABOVE TREND) while Technology is weak, so mixed signals warrant restraint.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate strong: WELL (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +6.14%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities showing support on wins.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Materials also under pressure.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND; MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND; DHR (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 all Healthcare) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DOW (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND; FCX (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND; NKE (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND; CME (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology and select cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: ABBV (1W: +17.03%), MRK (1W: +12.99%), JNJ (1W: +11.50%). No major divergence between 1W and 1M in these leaders; moves are confirmed rather than one-day spikes.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology remains under pressure with broad selling: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -16.24% | 1M: -18.56%) BELOW TREND. Sector is signaling weakness and needs stabilization before signaling rotation back to growth.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed but steady: JPM (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.75% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND; CME (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND is a notable outlier. Overall Financials breadth is positive but select names are under pressure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is the clear leader: LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +12.06%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND. Breadth and news catalysts are driving sector strength; leadership is narrow but strong.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Healthcare leaders and selective Financials while reducing exposure to large-cap Technology laggards showing persistent BELOW TREND action; style is mixed with concentrated healthcare leadership. Monitor concentration risk given Top 5 are all Healthcare.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND; ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +12.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND; CME (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (sector gains led by major names; breadth positive); Real Estate (WELL, VTR showing strength). BEARISH: Technology (sector-wide selling); Consumer Discretionary (NKE weakness).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim its 1M intra-range as a trigger for further downside; AAPL holding recent 1W lows would be needed to signal base stabilization; JPM holding 1W gains and extending above prior 1M highs would confirm Financial continuation; JNJ sustaining post-news gains would signal further sector follow-through.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+55): Beats lawsuit headline; price confirming—JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. UNH (+55): AI cost-cutting headline; UNH (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +12.06%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. MA (+60): settlement approval; MA (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming modest upside. PLTR (+65): US Army deal; PLTR (1W: -12.10% | 1M: -14.78%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price diverging, watch for distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-75): clinical/CFO concerns; PFE (1W: -3.65% | 1M: -7.33%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. ORCL (-45): debt concerns; ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. CME (-45): price-target cuts; CME (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) showing strength while NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) and AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) are BELOW TREND. Key risk is narrow healthcare leadership versus broad Technology weakness and several news/price divergences (PLTR bullish sentiment but BELOW TREND).
